main_text.p: ΓΡΟΣ ΤΟΥΣ ΕΠΙΜΕΛΗΤΑΣ, ΚΑΘΑ ΠΕ-ΡΙ ΤΗΣ ΝΕΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΥ ΣΙΤΟΥ ΕΙΡΗ-ΤΑΙ. ΚΑΤΑ ΤΑΥΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΔΙΚΗ ΑΥΤΩι ΜΗ ΕΣΤΩ ΠΕΡΙ ΤΟΥ ΑΡΓΥΡΙΟΥ, Ο ΑΝ ΕΚΔΩι ΑΛΛΟΣΕΠΗ Η ΑΘΗΝΑΖΕ· ΜΗ-ΔΕ ΑΡΧΗ ΕΙΣΑΓΕΤΩ ΠΕΡΙ ΤΟΥΤΟΥ ΜΗΔΕΜΙΑ.

p.i: describitor, quae madmodum de naue & frumento cautum est Lege. Ad hac ei a-ftio ne dator aduersus debitorem, cui mutuam pecuniā nauticam dedit in alium quā Athenienfium mercatum: neque Magistratus vllus iudices illi dato.

main_text.p: Legem ἀτελείας [?] laudat Demosthenes ἐν τοῖς πρὸς Λάχητα [?]. [illegible, ~40 letters]. ΑΡΓΥΡΙΟΝ ΔΕ ΜΗ ΕΞΕΙΝΑΙ ΕΚΔΟΥΝΑΙ, &c. Quae Lex non tantum Athenienfibus ciuibus fcripta eft, fed etiam inquilinis: ΩΝ ΟΥΤΟΙ ΚΥΡΙΟΙ ΕΙΣΙΝ, id eft, qui rerum fuarum domini funt: Nam fi, exempli gratia, tutor in hanc Legem commififfet, & pecuniam pupilli fui mutuam nauticam dediffet, in pupillum hac Lege non agebatur, vt qui rerum fuarum per ætatem non effet dominus, fed in tutorem. Aduerfus eos igitur, qui pecuniam fuam credidiffent mercatoribus alibi, quam Athenis, negotiantibus, fcribebatur φάσις, & pecunia, quam mutuam dederant, defcribebatur, vt in ærariū publicum inferretur, quod fieri folebat aduerfus illos, qui frumentum alio, quam Athenas, importabant: neque vlla competebat actio creditori aduerfus debitorem de exfoluendo debito. Scribebatur autem ἡ φάσις καὶ ἡ ἀπογραφὴ ΠΡΟΣ ΤΟΥΣ ΕΠΙΜΕΛΗΤΑΣ. ij funt Mercatus Curatores, de quibus Grammatici: Επιμελητὴς ἐμπορίων. Δεκάρχης δὲ τὰς τὴν Γυθίας, Αεισοτέλης, ἐμπο-ρίῳ δὲ Επιμελητὴς δίκας καὶ [?] ἐγκαλέσων, [illegible, ~30 letters], ἐμπορίων, [?] [illegible, ~40 letters]. [illegible, ~20 letters].
Lege tenebantur nauicularij vectoresque in eum appellere mercatum, de quo inter eos illosque, qui pecuniam suam crediderant, conuenisset: si secus facerent, seuere in illos animaduertebatur.
Τοὺς ναυκλήρους καὶ τοὺς ἐπιβάτας πλεῖν εἰς ὅ,π ἀὶ σιωπῶν ἐμπόριον· Εἰ δὲ μή, ζημιοῦσθαι.

p.i: Nauicularij vectoresque in illum ap-pellunto mercatum, de quo pacti funt: si secus faxint, multantor.

main_text.p: Legis meminit Demosthenes ἐν τῷ Διονυσοδώρου. οἱ νόμοι κελεύουσι τοὺς ναυκλήρους καὶ τοὺς ἐπιβάτας πλεῖν εἰς ὅ,π ἀὶ σιωπῶν ἐμπόριον· Εἰ δὲ μή, τὰς μεγίστας ζημίας [?] εἰσφέρειν [?].

page.notes: Top Greek column is set in capitals with a fragment at its start (ΓΡΟΣ, probably ΠΡΟΣ, cut off); kept as printed. The Latin column beside it is italic. The Greek in the italic and small lines (Demosthenes passages, grammarian's list, final Greek paragraph) is hard to read on this scan; uncertain letters are marked [?] and unreadable stretches are marked as illegible. "a-ftio" is printed this way and is kept as printed. The first Greek word of the main paragraph (ἀτελείας) and the Lacritus reference are doubtful. No marginal notes on this page.
